# Epic Hot Tubs & Swim Spas

> North Carolina's premier hot tub, swim spa, and sauna dealer offering in-stock inventory, free delivery, and professional installation across the Triangle and beyond.

Epic Hot Tubs specializes in Wellis Spa products and other premium brands with multiple showroom locations in Raleigh, Durham, and Sanford. The company provides comprehensive services including delivery, installation, repair, water care, and financing options to make outdoor living accessible.
